verdict.rationale: The Sales Cloud pricing page lists "AI Automatically Syncs Emails, Events, and Contacts" as a first-party capability, which covers the core idea of automatic email sync and capture. That is the only relevant mention, and it never names Gmail or Outlook, two-way sync, or record-matching logic. Missing for 10: explicit Gmail/Outlook connectors, documented two-way sync behavior, automatic logging/association to the correct records, setup docs for ops users, independent or hands-on corroboration.
